metadata.title: KP04 · Singular value decomposition
metadata.description: Reasoning-led 2.3.1; editable native teaching deck; global manual mode; no narration.

rectangular-title.name: rectangular-title
rectangular-title.text: Can a rectangular table be split into directions and strengths?

rectangular-context.name: rectangular-context
rectangular-context.text: Use four centered observations with two features each; observations are rows and rank is two.

rectangular-source.name: rectangular-source
rectangular-source.text: PR · KP04 · 1/9  |  Handout §1,§2  |  Manual Next / Prev

rectangular-bubble.name: rectangular-bubble
rectangular-bubble.text: Track factor dimensions to identify left directions, strengths, and right directions.

directions-title.name: directions-title
directions-title.text: Why are left and right directions different?

directions-context.name: directions-context
directions-context.text: $\mathbf q_j$ lies in the two-dimensional input space; $\mathbf p_j$ lies in four-dimensional output space. Singular value $s_j\ge0$.

directions-source.name: directions-source
directions-source.text: PR · KP04 · 2/9  |  Handout §3  |  Manual Next / Prev

directions-bubble.name: directions-bubble
directions-bubble.text: Follow the forward and transposed paths to see why squared strengths appear.

factors-title.name: factors-title
factors-title.text: Where do the three factors come from?

factors-context.name: factors-context
factors-context.text: Use a compact real decomposition; each direction set is orthonormal. Full forms add zero directions.

factors-source.name: factors-source
factors-source.text: PR · KP04 · 3/9  |  Handout §2,§4  |  Manual Next / Prev

factors-bubble.name: factors-bubble
factors-bubble.text: Check squared strengths first, then verify factor dimensions and signs.

outer-products-title.name: outer-products-title
outer-products-title.text: Do two rank-one patterns recover the table?

outer-products-context.name: outer-products-context
outer-products-context.text: An outer product multiplies a column by a row. Each $s_j\mathbf p_j\mathbf q_j^T$ has one independent direction.

outer-products-source.name: outer-products-source
outer-products-source.text: PR · KP04 · 4/9  |  Handout §4  |  Manual Next / Prev

outer-products-bubble.name: outer-products-bubble
outer-products-bubble.text: Add corresponding entries of both patterns and check every original row.

rank-one-title.name: rank-one-title
rank-one-title.text: How much error follows from discarding a pattern?

rank-one-context.name: rank-one-context
rank-one-context.text: Use the same four-by-two matrix and retain its first term. $\|\cdot\|_F^2$ sums squared entries.

rank-one-source.name: rank-one-source
rank-one-source.text: PR · KP04 · 5/9  |  Handout §5  |  Manual Next / Prev

rank-one-bubble.name: rank-one-bubble
rank-one-bubble.text: Square the residual entries, then compare their sum with the discarded squared singular value.

pca-link-title.name: pca-link-title
pca-link-title.text: How do singular values connect to PCA variance?

pca-link-context.name: pca-link-context
pca-link-context.text: Conditions: $A=X_c$ is centered, $n=4$, and covariance uses $1/n$.

pca-link-source.name: pca-link-source
pca-link-source.text: PR · KP04 · 6/9  |  Handout §6  |  Manual Next / Prev

pca-link-bubble.name: pca-link-bubble
pca-link-bubble.text: Trace right directions and squared strengths into the covariance decomposition.

centering-title.name: centering-title
centering-title.text: Does decomposing raw and centered data answer the same question?

centering-context.name: centering-context
centering-context.text: SVD applies to any real rectangular matrix; PCA directions describe variation after subtracting the mean.

centering-source.name: centering-source
centering-source.text: PR · KP04 · 7/9  |  Handout §6,§7  |  Manual Next / Prev

centering-bubble.name: centering-bubble
centering-bubble.text: Compare a raw-data path with a centered-data path and identify which geometry each describes.

centering-center.name: centering-center
centering-center.text:
$A=X-\mathbf1\mu^T$
Right singular directions are PCA directions

limits-title.name: limits-title
limits-title.text: What does optimal low rank actually guarantee?

limits-context.name: limits-context
limits-context.text: Compare matrices with rank at most $m$, rather than all classifiers or nonlinear representations.

limits-source.name: limits-source
limits-source.text: PR · KP04 · 8/9  |  Handout §3,§8  |  Manual Next / Prev

limits-bubble.name: limits-bubble
limits-bubble.text: Separate error, storage, and task criteria and inspect their conditions.

limits-storage.name: limits-storage
limits-storage.text:
$m(n+d+1)<nd$
needed for a direct parameter-count saving

limits-applications.name: limits-applications
limits-applications.text:
Latent semantic indexing (LSI)
Retrieval / compression / recommendation

limits-risk-label.name: limits-risk-label
limits-risk-label.text: A weak signal can matter; individual distances and labels have no automatic guarantee.

limits-numerics.name: limits-numerics
limits-numerics.text: $\begin{gathered}\mathbb R:\ A=P\Sigma Q^T,\ A^TA\mathbf q_j=s_j^2\mathbf q_j\\\mathbb C:\ A=P\Sigma Q^H,\ A^HA\mathbf q_j=s_j^2\mathbf q_j\end{gathered}$

new-spectrum-title.name: new-spectrum-title
new-spectrum-title.text: Calculate truncation costs for a new spectrum

new-spectrum-context.name: new-spectrum-context
new-spectrum-context.text: New centered data have $n=9$ observations and singular values $6,2,1$ in descending order.

new-spectrum-source.name: new-spectrum-source
new-spectrum-source.text: PR · KP04 · 9/9  |  Handout §9  |  Manual Next / Prev

new-spectrum-bubble.name: new-spectrum-bubble
new-spectrum-bubble.text: Retain two terms: find total squared error and mean squared error per observation and covariance eigenvalues. Does this guarantee better classification?

new-spectrum-target.name: new-spectrum-target
new-spectrum-target.text:
Keep the first two terms
Discard the third
